'''June 2001 Billings tournament (Endor draft)''' was a Star Wars CCG local (booster draft) held in Billings, Montana on 24 June 2001. Preston won it. It is known from Travis Rumans's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2513">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-24-mt-and-wo-6-22-6-24-triple-trd2513/ mt-and-wo-6-22-6-24-triple-tr], DeckTech (Travis "Com Igar" Rumans, 24 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-24-mt-and-wo-6-22-6-24-triple-trd2513/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Billings, Montana
* '''Format:''' [[Endor Draft]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' Preston
